title: As Student Rollouts Continue, Visual Backdoors Keep Growing
abstract: arXiv:2611.22446v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conventional knowledge distillation can facilitate the propagation of backdoors from teacher models to student models. However, how this risk manifests in On-Policy Distillation (OPD) remains insufficiently studied. OPD has recently emerged as an important post-training paradigm for Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Unlike traditional offline distillation, OPD does not require teacher-generated responses. Instead, it uses the teacher's probability distributions to supervise response trajectories generated online by the student. Since the initial student model typically generates benign responses and receives no explicit supervision from malicious target responses, OPD appears to offer some inherent resistance to backdoor propagation.   In this paper, we challenge this intuition and reveal a more subtle risk of visual backdoor propagation in OPD. translated_title: 随着学生模型持续展开生成，视觉后门不断增长
translated_abstract: 传统知识蒸馏可能促使后门从教师模型传播到学生模型。然而，这种风险在在线策略蒸馏中如何表现，目前研究尚不充分。OPD 近来已成为视觉-语言模型（VLM）的一种重要后训练范式。与传统离线蒸馏不同，OPD 不需要教师生成的响应，而是利用教师的概率分布来监督学生模型在线生成的响应轨迹。由于初始学生模型通常生成良性响应，且不会从恶意目标响应中获得显式监督，OPD 似乎对后门传播具有某种固有的抵抗力。本文挑战了这一直觉，揭示了 OPD 中视觉后门传播的一种更隐蔽的风险。通过在多个模型家族和数据集上的实验，并结合理论分析……
tldr: 本文挑战了“在线策略蒸馏（OPD）对后门传播具有天然抵抗力”的直觉，通过多模型家族与数据集上的实验及理论分析，揭示了视觉后门会随着学生模型在线展开生成而持续传播增长的隐蔽风险。
en_tdlr: This paper challenges the intuition that On-Policy Distillation (OPD) inherently resists backdoor propagation, revealing through experiments and theoretical analysis that visual backdoors keep growing as student rollouts continue.
